attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: not greatly educated but of much faith, who preached to one man at a time because he could not teach in public, took to the desert life, came down into the cities only to scatter benefits, healed by the laying on of his hands, and whose relic gave out myrrh. The page gives no year, no country and no monastery, so no `dates` and no `locations`. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
